entry: Recipe — Cooking pm into a rhythmic phrase
claim: § What you should hear: "pm sounds still ... There is no momentum. The mirror cancels it." The mirror map n -> 17 - n is a true time reflection, so this is the recipe whose audible claim is cleanest to test.

pieces.what: Writes a half-phrase, mirrors it at n -> 17 - n, and plays it against the same half under translation, letting the reader hear whether the mirror stills the phrase
Silences one mirror hit and plays before and after, testing 'the phrase suddenly lurches'
